implement_ExperimentLogger_subclass: implement a subclass of ExperimentLogger that provides concrete logging methods for hyperparams, metrics, audio, image, and text
log_hyperparams: log experiment hyperparameters as a dictionary or argparse Namespace with optional final metrics to the ExperimentLogger
log_metrics: log a dictionary of metrics with optional name prefixes and step numbers to the ExperimentLogger
log_audio: log an audio tensor with a key, sample rate, and optional step number to the ExperimentLogger
log_image: log an image tensor with a key and optional step number to the ExperimentLogger
